messages.content:
someone reply to me
I think this is hard to compare. You use bandwidth as you need. With AI there in an incentive to maximise usage: 10x, 100x or 1000x engineer. The proposition is the more tokens you burn the more output you generate. Not seeing a ceiling yet.

my reply back
Well brother, you're right. It's too early to tell but I'd bet token consumption optimization will die soon. If AI going to be woven into the fabric of economies then token costs have to be come little to nothing just like the internet.

The internet started as optional, people slowly adopted as cost went down.

DeepSeek and Xiaomi slashed their pricing 75% and 99% a couple weeks back...

There will always be a room for such projects but I think it will be less relevant.


improve my reply so it's simple and easy to understand

don't make ti toolong

You're right — too early to call it. But I think token costs are headed to zero, same as the internet. When something becomes infrastructure, the price has to disappear.

DeepSeek and Xiaomi already slashed prices 75% and 99% a couple weeks ago. That trend only goes one direction.

Optimization will matter less and less. There'll always be room for it, but it won't be the bottleneck.
